title: PeerTransportManifestView
description: Source of truth: libp2p Swarm + iroh Endpoint observations (Operational, Category C). Persisted via peer_transport_manifest SQLite table for hybrid-window transport selection. Rebuildable from observed handshake arrivals on either transport. Per spec 2026-05-08-iroh-libp2p-complementarity §peer-transport-manifest.

agentCid.description: Canonical DHT-anchored agent identity (imagodei). Stable across transports.

libp2p.description: libp2p transport profile if peer speaks libp2p. Null when only iroh-observed.

iroh.description: iroh transport profile if peer speaks iroh. Null when only libp2p-observed.

discovery.description: Discovery methods that surfaced this peer.

capabilityLevel.description: Device-archetype capability tier: 0=unknown, 1=wearable, 2=phone, 3=laptop, 4=always-on full node, 5=hub default.

lastObserved.description: Unix epoch seconds of the last observation.

supports.description: Planes this peer supports over libp2p.

nodeId.description: iroh NodeId (32-byte ed25519 pubkey, base32 encoded).

relays.description: Relay URLs the peer is reachable through.

supports.description: Planes this peer supports over iroh.
